event: Nala yawns and stretches under the covers, then climbs out of the wide bed, naked.
The amber in the quarters has brightened to morning gold along the panelled walls.
She opens the door onto the short passage, and the creak comes louder from the hall ahead.
At the passage's end, beside the Check-in Counter, two tall shapes wait in the gold light.
They are thin and faceless, pale oak and brass, long jointed arms hanging at their sides.
Neither moves toward her; both are turned to the Counter, still, as if waiting on a word.
One tilts its blank head toward the passage with a slow creak of wood and brass.
